ops.title: forge-studio can no longer self-converge to captain-hook 12.22.5 — its stalled updater needs one manual `capt-hook helper install`
ops.description:
Consequence of shipping captain-hook 12.22.5, recorded 2026-08-30 so it is not mistaken for a regression.

`yasyf-forge-studio` is **deliberately** held at helper 12.22.3 while its Cellar is ahead — a decided position recorded in runbook `68af1c77`, because the deployment path that would converge it has the live drain bug `cffb17aa` that wedged that host once.

**What changed.** Its installed host runs the pre-12.22.5 updater, whose only deploying step was the formula's `post_install`. 12.22.5 **deletes `post_install`** and moves the deploy into `capt-hook helper install` / `run_update`'s new shared `deploy()`. So the old updater's escalation lane — `brew reinstall`, previously the thing that re-ran `post_install` and actually superseded the app — now deploys nothing at all. forge-studio will run its brew lanes, fail `host_at_least`, burn `MAX_ESCALATIONS`, and log `update stalled` indefinitely.

That is not new breakage: it was already exit-1-ing on every brew lane and never converging. But it is now **permanent** rather than merely failing, and the escape is a single documented command rather than a lucky partial success.

**The fix is one manual pass on that host**, deliberately not done from this session: converging it supersedes a live daemon, `cffb17aa` is still open, and that host's Claude OAuth is expired (`e240c0b5`) so the runbook's own proof step cannot run there to confirm the result. Both should be settled in one visit.

**Note the uv-cache trap**, hit on this workstation: `uv tool install --force 'capt-hook==12.22.5'` fails with "no version of capt-hook==12.22.5" even though PyPI's simple index serves the wheel. `uv cache clean capt-hook` first, then the install succeeds. Without a 12.22.5 shim on PATH, `capt-hook helper install` runs the old code and does not deploy.</body>

ops.text: On forge-studio, the uv shim is converged to 12.22.5 (`uv cache clean capt-hook` first — uv serves a stale index otherwise), then `capt-hook helper install` is run and exits 0 naming 12.22.5
`launchctl list | grep -E 'captain-hook|capt-hook'` shows both agents at status 0 afterwards, and `capt-hook helper status` reports v12.22.5
A fresh session's `capt-hook heartbeats --session <id>` shows a populated ledger (blocked today by the expired OAuth in e240c0b5 — that has to be fixed first or the proof step cannot run)
